description.narrative: The main objective of institutional strengthening (IS) is to provide a national institutional mechanism for co-ordinating national and international efforts for the protection of the ozone layer generally and in particular facilitate actions aimed at speedy phase-out of ozone depleting substances. The main activities are the current ongoing phase are: build national capacity and enhance regulatory efforts to achieve compliance with upcoming HCFCs consumption phase-out target; monitor the promulgation and enforcement of policy and legislation focusing on the additional restrictions on HCFCs; cooperate with the customs sector to prevent illegal trade in controlled substances, and with the RAC equipment association; continue the implementation of stage II of the HPMP, upgrade the HFC outlook model, prepare the project proposal for the Kigali HFC implementation plan; continue awareness activities and attendance at regional and international meetings; continue cooperation with climate authorities on inclusion of F-gases in the Nationally-determined contributions, and with the authorities responsible for safety standards and energy efficiency; and integrate gender mainstreaming into implementation of the IS project.
